import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import java.util.stream.IntStream;
import java.util.stream.StreamSupport;

/**
 * Stock-JVM proof of the M3StringFacts line-terminator measure. LineTerminatorKernel and
 * LinesHolder are generated by run_proof.sh from the head sources (the method and class text is
 * copied, never retyped). The oracle is java.util.regex over the same text plus String.lines().
 * Prints one row per check: name, cases, mismatches. Exit 1 on a mismatch or a surviving
 * discriminator.
 */
public final class LineTerminatorProof {
    private static final Pattern TERMINATOR = Pattern.compile("\r\n|\r|\n");
    private static final char[] SMALL = {'a', '\n', '\r'};
    private static final char[] WIDE = {
        'a', 'b', ' ', '\n', '\r', (char) 0x0B, (char) 0x0C, (char) 0x85, (char) 0x2028,
        (char) 0x2029, (char) 0xD83D, (char) 0xDE42
    };
    private static final int SMALL_MAX_LENGTH = 9;
    private static final int WIDE_CASES = 200_000;
    private static final int WIDE_MAX_LENGTH = 24;
    private static final long SEED = 20261116L;
    private static int failures;

    /** One side of a composition: the measure plus the edge units the seam rule reads. */
    record Part(int count, char first, char last, int length) {
        static Part of(String text) {
            return text.isEmpty()
                    ? new Part(0, (char) 0, (char) 0, 0)
                    : new Part(fold(text, true), text.charAt(0), text.charAt(text.length() - 1),
                            text.length());
        }

        Part join(Part right) {
            if (length == 0) return right;
            if (right.length == 0) return this;
            return new Part(
                    LineTerminatorKernel.lineTerminatorSeam(count, last, right.count, right.first),
                    first, right.last, length + right.length);
        }
    }

    private LineTerminatorProof() {}

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        List<String> small = smallCorpus();
        List<String> wide = wideCorpus();
        report("fold_gated_vs_regex_small", small, text -> fold(text, true) == oracle(text));
        report("fold_gated_vs_regex_wide", wide, text -> fold(text, true) == oracle(text));
        report("fold_ungated_vs_gated_wide", wide, text -> fold(text, false) == fold(text, true));
        report("lines_count_relation_small", small, LineTerminatorProof::linesRelation);
        report("lines_count_relation_wide", wide, LineTerminatorProof::linesRelation);
        report("compose_every_cut_small", small, LineTerminatorProof::everyCut);
        report("compose_every_cut_wide", wide, LineTerminatorProof::everyCut);
        report("compose_associative_small", small, LineTerminatorProof::everyTwoCuts);
        report("lines_consumer_flag_false_small", small, text -> sameLines(text, false));
        report("lines_consumer_flag_measure_small", small, text -> sameLines(text, measured(text)));
        report("lines_consumer_flag_measure_wide", wide, text -> sameLines(text, measured(text)));
        discriminator("naive_sum_without_seam_rule", naiveSeam("a\r", "\nb") != oracle("a\r\nb"));
        discriminator("forced_flag_on_text_with_terminator", !sameLines("a\nb", true));
        discriminator("step_without_cr_memory", fold("\r\n", true) != 2);
        System.out.println("RESULT\t" + (failures == 0 ? "PASS" : "FAIL") + "\tfailures=" + failures);
        System.exit(failures == 0 ? 0 : 1);
    }

    private static List<String> smallCorpus() {
        return IntStream.rangeClosed(0, SMALL_MAX_LENGTH).boxed()
                .flatMap(length -> IntStream.range(0, (int) Math.pow(SMALL.length, length))
                        .mapToObj(code -> digits(code, length)))
                .toList();
    }

    private static String digits(int code, int length) {
        char[] text = new char[length];
        int[] rest = {code};
        IntStream.range(0, length).forEach(index -> {
            text[index] = SMALL[rest[0] % SMALL.length];
            rest[0] /= SMALL.length;
        });
        return new String(text);
    }

    private static List<String> wideCorpus() {
        Random random = new Random(SEED);
        return IntStream.range(0, WIDE_CASES).mapToObj(index -> {
            char[] text = new char[random.nextInt(WIDE_MAX_LENGTH + 1)];
            IntStream.range(0, text.length)
                    .forEach(at -> text[at] = WIDE[random.nextInt(WIDE.length)]);
            return new String(text);
        }).toList();
    }

    private static boolean vertical(char unit) {
        return (unit >= '\n' && unit <= '\r') || unit == 0x85 || unit == 0x2028 || unit == 0x2029;
    }

    static int fold(String text, boolean gated) {
        int[] state = {0, 0};
        text.chars().forEach(unit -> {
            if (!gated || vertical((char) unit)) {
                state[0] += LineTerminatorKernel.lineTerminatorStep((char) state[1], (char) unit);
            }
            state[1] = unit;
        });
        return state[0];
    }

    private static int oracle(String text) {
        return (int) TERMINATOR.matcher(text).results().count();
    }

    private static boolean linesRelation(String text) {
        boolean openTail = !text.isEmpty() && !text.endsWith("\n") && !text.endsWith("\r");
        return text.lines().count() == oracle(text) + (openTail ? 1 : 0);
    }

    private static boolean everyCut(String text) {
        return IntStream.rangeClosed(0, text.length()).allMatch(cut ->
                Part.of(text.substring(0, cut)).join(Part.of(text.substring(cut))).count()
                        == oracle(text));
    }

    private static boolean everyTwoCuts(String text) {
        return IntStream.rangeClosed(0, text.length()).allMatch(first ->
                IntStream.rangeClosed(first, text.length()).allMatch(second ->
                        associative(text, first, second)));
    }

    private static boolean associative(String text, int first, int second) {
        Part a = Part.of(text.substring(0, first));
        Part b = Part.of(text.substring(first, second));
        Part c = Part.of(text.substring(second));
        int expected = oracle(text);
        return a.join(b).join(c).count() == expected && a.join(b.join(c)).count() == expected;
    }

    private static boolean measured(String text) {
        return fold(text, true) == 0;
    }

    private static boolean sameLines(String text, boolean terminatorFree) {
        List<String> actual = StreamSupport.stream(
                new LinesHolder.M3LinesSpliterator(text, terminatorFree), false).toList();
        return actual.equals(text.lines().toList());
    }

    private static int naiveSeam(String left, String right) {
        return fold(left, true) + fold(right, true);
    }

    private static void report(String name, List<String> corpus,
            java.util.function.Predicate<String> check) {
        long mismatches = corpus.stream().filter(check.negate()).count();
        failures += mismatches == 0 ? 0 : 1;
        System.out.println(name + "\t" + corpus.size() + "\t" + mismatches);
    }

    private static void discriminator(String name, boolean detected) {
        failures += detected ? 0 : 1;
        System.out.println("discriminator:" + name + "\t1\t" + (detected ? "KILLED" : "SURVIVED"));
    }
}
